features: Adds Bachata, Salsa and BDC Dance Cup tabs to the public Leaderboard with Bachata as the default
Keeps Bachata and Salsa leaderboard points completely isolated by dance_style while reusing the existing Novice, Intermediate and Advanced progression rules
Adds BDC Dance Cup placement-only leaderboard/results views with no BDC points allocation
Adds Bachata, Salsa and BDC Dance Cup tabs to public Results and Competitor Career Profile pages
Removes mixed career-point presentation from competitor profiles and shows discipline-specific points and histories instead
Adds competition type and dance style selection to New Registration and Update Profile while preserving one shared BDC ID
Adds bdc_competitor_discipline_profiles so Bachata and Salsa can store independent role and division data under the same competitor identity
Backfills existing competitor competition profiles as Bachata only and does not invent Salsa history
Updates admin Profile Requests to display and approve Jack & Jill discipline selections without allowing Salsa updates to overwrite Bachata profile fields
Keeps the homepage Career Points Leaders Bachata-only by default so future Salsa points cannot silently mix into the established leaderboard
No manual Staging or Production deployment performed; automatic deployment status must be verified separately
